object: Q[n,k] = number of k-element pairwise-coprime subsets of [n], including the empty set at k=0
method: Exact memoized independence-polynomial recurrence on the coprimality graph, with a separate direct recursive enumeration for small n.
external_crosscheck: Coefficients agree with the Q[n,k] table in Goh and Saks (2024) for the overlapping n<=17 range.
scope_note: Exact finite computation only; it does not establish the all-n conjecture.
